verdicts.human_summary: Race condition: ensureWatchers() is fire-and-forget, so if unsubscribe happens before setupWatchers() finishes, cleanup runs before watchers exist and the in-flight setup creates watchers afterward, leaking open FSWatchers with no callbacks.
verdicts.reasoning: AI Comment 2 identifies the same fundamental architectural issue: a race condition between unsubscribe and the in-flight watcher setup in ensureWatchers(). Both comments point to the same root cause (void this.ensureWatchers() fire-and-forget combined with synchronous cleanup not properly coordinating with the async setup), the same code area, and suggest fixes that involve clearing/nulling watcherSetupInFlight during cleanup. While the specific failure scenario differs slightly (human: leaked watchers; AI: subscriber without notifications), the underlying concern about improper concurrency coordination is the same.
